Name: Dotfiles
Author: Garvit Pahal
Description: Open the folder or file in front in Zed, Ghostty, or the file manager, open Chrome, a new Chrome tab, Gmail, T3 Code, or Claude, and show live system stats

Actions.Name: Overview
Actions.Tooltip: Show CPU and memory use; press for the page of system stats

Actions.Name: Editor
Actions.Tooltip: Open the folder or file in front in Zed

Actions.Name: Terminal
Actions.Tooltip: Open Ghostty at the folder in front

Actions.Name: Files
Actions.Tooltip: Show the folder or file in front in the file manager

Actions.Name: Chrome
Actions.Tooltip: Open Google Chrome, or bring it to the front

Actions.Name: New Tab
Actions.Tooltip: Open a new Chrome tab with the clipboard's text pasted and selected

Actions.Name: Gmail
Actions.Tooltip: Bring Chrome's Gmail tab to the front, or open Gmail in a new tab

Actions.Name: T3 Code
Actions.Tooltip: Open T3 Code, or bring it to the front

Actions.Name: Claude
Actions.Tooltip: Open Claude, or bring it to the front

Actions.Name: CPU
Actions.Tooltip: CPU use over the last minute; press for Activity Monitor

Actions.Name: Memory
Actions.Tooltip: Memory used, colored by memory pressure; press for Activity Monitor

Actions.Name: Swap
Actions.Tooltip: Swap used; press for Activity Monitor

Actions.Name: Top Process
Actions.Tooltip: The process using the most CPU; press for Activity Monitor

Actions.Name: GPU
Actions.Tooltip: GPU use over the last minute, from macmon; press for Activity Monitor

Actions.Name: Temperature
Actions.Tooltip: CPU and GPU temperature, from macmon; press for Activity Monitor

Actions.Name: Power
Actions.Tooltip: Power drawn by the Mac, the CPU, and the GPU, from macmon; press for Activity Monitor

Actions.Name: Disk
Actions.Tooltip: Free space on the startup disk; press for Activity Monitor

Actions.Name: Network
Actions.Tooltip: Download and upload speed; press for Activity Monitor

Actions.Name: Activity Monitor
Actions.Tooltip: Open Activity Monitor, or bring it to the front

Actions.Name: Back
Actions.Tooltip: Return to the main page
